candidateDeltaAudit.method: Static, read-only diff and blob comparison on the checked-out source repository (git diff --stat/-U2/-U3, git show <commit>:<path>, grep for the flag literals, frozen constants and model-visible instruction text) against the contracts scripts/frontier-harness-harness.mjs and tools/frontier-harness-agent consume. It did not build or run the CLI; the smoke run below is the execution evidence.
candidateDeltaAudit.interfaceContract: NO BLOCKING CHANGE. Every flag the plugin passes still exists with the same meaning: the only flag literals added anywhere in the diff are two entries in an argv composition list ('--workspace-grant write' and '--attempt-evidence <path>'), and no flag literal is removed. apps/cli/src/v3-attempt-evidence.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-provider-config.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-execution-profile.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-request-budget.ts and packages/v3-thread-store/src/usage-accounting.ts are unchanged between the two commits, so the evidence JSONL shape and the thread_metrics read path are byte-identical. apps/cli/product-manifest.json is unchanged.
candidateDeltaAudit.modelVisibleChanges: MATERIAL. The code-intelligence tool package is removed from the product composition (commit 98baa9678, 'remove(lsp): drop dedicated tools and preserve generic fixtures'): the four bindings best-agent/code-intelligence-tools/{definition,references,diagnostics,symbols}-v1 and their 'code-intelligence' approval profile no longer compose, so the baseline run's model had four tools this run's model does not. WORKSPACE_TOOL_ROUTING_INSTRUCTION_TEXT (apps/cli/src/product-slices/workspace-tools.ts) is rewritten: 1,488 -> 1,961 source bytes, replacing the attempt-lease/progress paragraph with an explicit tool-loop paragraph. COMPACTED_CONTEXT_INSTRUCTION_TEXT (apps/cli/src/v3-prompt-composition.ts) is rewritten in place (+79 bytes in the file) around steer/workReport/current-request precedence. The base agent instruction text and the capability-builtin-tools / capability-tool-catalog packages are unchanged, and no tool was added.
candidateDeltaAudit.attemptDeliveryChanges: The attempt window floor moves from 210,000 ms to ATTEMPT_RESERVE_MS = 60,000 ms (30,000 ms stop settlement + 30,000 ms cleanup reserve) in apps/cli/src/v3-run-options.ts, and the '--attempt-remaining-ms' prompt-room check that refused a prompt larger than MAX_USER_MESSAGE_BYTES - 66,000 is deleted. Together with the benchmarks-side plugin guard (harnessDelta), an attempt can now start with a 60-210 s window where the baseline would have refused it outright.
candidateDeltaAudit.frozenQuantities: No change to DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_PROCESS_LIFETIME_MS, MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS_PER_MODEL_CYCLE, SERVER_MAX_MODEL_CYCLES, COMPACT_ROUND_BOUND_MS or the terminal-cause vocabulary: the diff of those constants across apps/cli/src/v3-run-options.ts, v3-request-budget.ts, v3-execution-profile.ts and v3/src/plan.ts is empty. The per-call ceiling this run materializes is still the frozen 1,800,000 ms and every cell keeps its own official agent budget.
candidateDeltaAudit.otherBehavior: apps/cli/src/index.ts now defaults DIMCODE_VERSION to the CLI's own version (and restores a caller-supplied value across an upgrade relaunch); capability-network-tools (search providers, empty-result and error-body handling) and capability-ocr (office source handling) change implementation. The network ToolBinding is excluded by the frozen composition, and OCR membership is unchanged.
candidateDeltaAudit.reading: The candidate is not inert: a task model meets four fewer tools, a rewritten workspace routing instruction and a rewritten compacted-context instruction, and an attempt may start with a much shorter remaining window than before. Any verdict difference against run 39883822819 must be read as this delta plus run-to-run variance, never as a single-variable capability claim.

provider.note: Identical to 39883822819, 39793858384 and 39557190033: same model, same effort, same gateway, same credential. The materializer refuses any (model, effort) pair the frozen profile does not itself declare.

composition.stated: Public egress, no filtered-egress probe, no contamination gate, one attempt per cell, each cell's own declared budget, fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, the same grader, and the same seven digest-preserving image mirrors. The declared deltas are the candidate and one agent-plugin delivery guard (harnessDelta).
composition.whyTheseDeltasStayComparable: An image mirror changes where the same digest-pinned image is fetched from, never its bytes, so it cannot change what a cell measures. Parallelism is a scheduling choice only. The plugin guard only decides whether an attempt may start with a short remaining window; it changes no budget, timeout or grader.
composition.parallelism: fh_max_parallel=8, the width 39883822819 used with zero infrastructure errors.

harnessDelta.source: commit 265cc14ad57a56a5fdc773fa5aad73eda9e3793f ('fix: let the selected CLI admit positive attempt budgets', merged as 59232eb, PR #16), present on the dispatched ref before this freeze commit
harnessDelta.change: tools/frontier-harness-agent/frontier_harness_best_agent/__init__.py: after provider setup the plugin computes attempt_remaining_ms = attempt_budget_ms - wrapper_elapsed_ms and now raises 'No task attempt time remains after provider setup' only when attempt_remaining_ms <= 0; it previously refused at <= 210_000 ms.
harnessDelta.whyDisclosed: Run 39883822819 ran the pre-change plugin. A cell whose provider setup left less than 210 s of its own budget would have been refused there as a pre-model failure; with this plugin it can now start with that short window. No agent budget, per-call ceiling, timeout multiplier, task set or grader changes, but a recorded error class can therefore shrink for reasons unrelated to the candidate, so the two runs are not a single-variable comparison.

mitigation.imageMirror: The same seven digest-preserving GHCR mirrors 39883822819 used: the five seeded for the earlier recovery arm plus fastapi-deprecation-response-headers (sha256:b8c599ce29c14f9e729b3bab32ab7c1d3278b42f98308e74d299bb15e36758c6) and scc-bounded-memory-spilling (sha256:483e18c744ab845e5c776f514d4bc27f7e3ff66494f14f20173c73b065bc6f62). Each generate job re-proves the alias with the source registry blackholed before any model call. anko-typed-variable-bindings and httpx-multipart-response-parsing are still pulled from their frozen references, so a rate limit there would be recorded as infra, never as a model failure.
mitigation.noCleanClaim: No contamination gate and public egress, so this run claims no cell was clean. Any cell whose record is to be used as a capability reading still needs its own contamination receipt.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per cell over the exact frozen corpus; no second attempt in this manifest.
No verdict, frozen record or artifact of 39883822819, 39793858384, 39557190033, 39721121070 or any earlier run is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted by this run.
Nothing here is read as a model-capability result: with public egress and no contamination gate, a model failure cannot be separated from an answer source a cell may have reached.
Every error cell keeps its mechanical cause (environment build, rate limit, transport, budget) in the record; an error is never counted as a model failure.
A model.patch of 0 bytes means the collect hook graded the pristine tree; such a cell's f2p is not the model's work and the record says so.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.

knownRisks.ecrRateLimit: Seven of nine datacurve images are mirrored; anko and httpx are not, so an environment-build 429 is still possible and would be recorded as infra.
knownRisks.transport: 39883822819 lost 1,945.6 s to provider transport stalls in six cells and that directly decided two verdicts. Nothing in this candidate claims to fix it.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.emptyPatchCaptureGap: The datacurve collect hook diffs base..HEAD, so a cell that edits without committing still grades the pristine tree. Not changed here.
knownRisks.rerun: One attempt per cell. A cell that fails keeps its canonical verdict; no retry is admitted by this manifest.
knownRisks.noReproducibleBinary: The SEA build is not byte-reproducible, so this run's binarySha256 is its own; the receipt and the per-run candidateId are the only identity that binds the attempts to the pinned commit.
knownRisks.smokeGate: No full run is dispatched until a single-task smoke has proven the new candidate builds, delivery-verifies, materializes glm-5.3 at high and reaches the model phase with frozen evidence.
